title: The Eastern End Of Poor Alley
description: You are at the poor alley.  South of here is the Grubby Inn and to the east you see common square.  The alley continues further west.
items: A Peacekeeper is standing here, ready to jump in at the first sign of trouble.
A beastly fido is mucking through the garbage looking for food here.
